text:
Steven Stamkos is 36, and The Hockey News wrote this month that he's "on Pace to Demolish Franchise Record" in Nashville. He has 12 goals and 24 points in 23 games, 13 of the points on the power play, and a five-game point streak. He ranks eighth of 559 skaters in wins added by his goals.

There's a catch, and we flag it plainly: 12 goals on 9.2 expected (the quality of his chances), shooting 21% against 20% last season. He has always shot well, and our talent range puts his true rate near 17%, but this pace rarely lasts. His ice time is also down 1:19 a night over the last ten.

At five on five Nashville gets 44.4% of the expected goals with him on, about five points worse than without him. Last season ran the other way: Evolving-Hockey had his expected wins (2.6) well ahead of his actual (1.6), so some of this may be last year's chances finally going in. Sean McIndoe of The Athletic recently wondered whether stars like Stamkos have played their last playoff game. Watch whether the even-strength numbers rise to meet the goals.
